column1: # JoyPro's own names of X-Plane commands whose description is shorthand (written for JoyPro, not copied from the game).
# The name always replaces the title (ActionTexts.CorrectionGames). "ott" is X-Plane's autopilot ("otto", sim/cockpit2/autopilot/otto_*).

column2: Autopilot ALT/VVI selector display: show altitude
column4: The autopilot's shared selector display for altitude and vertical speed (ott_seldisp_ALT_VVI) shows the selected altitude.

column2: Autopilot ALT/VVI selector display: show vertical speed
column4: The autopilot's shared selector display for altitude and vertical speed (ott_seldisp_ALT_VVI) shows the selected vertical speed.
